a.hg: Pehla box kaam badalta hai: Waiting for QC, Spotting & touching, QC ledger (day-wise), Checks, Issued for alteration aur Received back from alteration. Aapko sirf wahi vie…

en: how to pass pieces in qc
hi: QC में पीस पास कैसे करें
hg: qc mein pieces pass kaise kare
waiting for qc kya hai

a.en: Choose Waiting for QC. Each row is a karigar's receipt, oldest first — type the pieces in the Pieces box and press QC pass.
a.hi: Waiting for QC चुनें। हर लाइन एक कारीगर की receipt है, सबसे पुरानी पहले — Pieces box में पीस लिखें और QC pass दबाएँ।
a.hg: Waiting for QC chuniye. Har line ek karigar ki receipt hai, sabse purani pehle — Pieces box mein pieces likhiye aur QC pass dabaiye.

hi: spotting में कैसे भेजें
hg: spotting mein kaise bheje
touching kya hai

a.en: In Waiting for QC, type the pieces and press Spotting for a stain or Touching for a missed or broken print. They come back later from the Spotting & touching view.
a.hi: Waiting for QC में पीस लिखें और दाग के लिए Spotting, छूटी या टूटी छपाई के लिए Touching दबाएँ। ये बाद में Spotting & touching व्यू से वापस आते हैं।
a.hg: Waiting for QC mein pieces likhiye aur daag ke liye Spotting, chhooti ya tooti chhapai ke liye Touching dabaiye. Yeh baad mein Spotting & touching view se wapas aate hain.

hi: spotting से पीस वापस कैसे लें
hg: spotting se pieces wapas kaise le
back qc pass kya hai

a.en: Choose Spotting & touching, type how many came back and press Back — QC pass, or press Reject if they are still not good. Type fewer for a part — the rest stays there.
a.hi: Spotting & touching चुनें, कितने वापस आए लिखें और Back — QC pass दबाएँ, या अब भी ठीक न हों तो Reject दबाएँ। कम लिखें तो सिर्फ़ उतने — बाकी वहीं रहेंगे।
a.hg: Spotting & touching chuniye, kitne wapas aaye likhiye aur Back — QC pass dabaiye, ya ab bhi theek na hon to Reject dabaiye. Kam likhiye to sirf utne — baaki wahin rahenge.

en: received pieces not showing in waiting for qc

hg: receive hua maal qc mein nahi dikh raha
waiting for qc mein entry nahi hai

a.hg: Pehle Job Work Register ka Refresh dabaiye (is screen ka Refresh sirf QC entries phir padhta hai), phir wapas aayein. Waiting for QC mein 5 October 2026 se Job Work Register mein mile pieces dikhte hain (purane LEG- o…

hi: QC का रोज़ का हिसाब
hg: qc ka roz ka hisab
aaj kitna qc hua

a.en: Choose QC ledger (day-wise). One row a day shows what came back from karigars, QC pass, sent to spotting and touching, back from them, for alteration and rejected. It shows the last 30 days unless you set the …
a.hi: QC ledger (day-wise) चुनें। हर दिन की एक लाइन में कारीगर से आए, QC pass, spotting और touching में गए, वहाँ से आए, alteration और reject — सब दिखता है। Dated तारीख न भरें तो पिछले 30 दिन दिखते हैं।
a.hg: QC ledger (day-wise) chuniye. Har din ki ek line mein karigar se aaye, QC pass, spotting aur touching mein gaye, wahan se aaye, alteration aur reject — sab dikhta hai. Dated date na bhariye to pichhle 30…

en: how to record a qc check
hi: QC चेक कैसे दर्ज करें
hg: qc check kaise record kare
alteration aur reject kaise likhe

a.en: Choose Checks, press + Record a check, pick the item (or type the SKU), Checked by and the Order No, type Checked, For alteration and Rejected, then press Save check…
a.hi: Checks चुनें, + Record a check दबाएँ, आइटम (या SKU), Checked by और Order No चुनें, Checked, For alteration और Rejected लिखें, फिर Save check दबाएँ।
a.hg: Checks chuniye, + Record a check dabaiye, item (ya SKU), Checked by aur Order No chuniye, Checked, For alteration aur Rejected likhiye, phir Save check dabaiye.

en: pick which one these pieces are for
hi: QC में ऑर्डर नंबर माँग रहा है
hg: qc mein order number maang raha hai
kaun sa order chune qc mein

a.en: This SKU is on more than one order. Pick in Order No the order these checked pieces belong to — if the SKU is on only one order, it fills itself.
a.hi: यह SKU एक से ज़्यादा ऑर्डर में है। Order No में वह ऑर्डर चुनें जिसके ये चेक हुए पीस हैं — SKU एक ही ऑर्डर में हो तो अपने आप भर जाता है।
a.hg: Yeh SKU ek se zyada order mein hai. Order No mein woh order chuniye jiske yeh check hue pieces hain — SKU ek hi order mein ho to apne aap bhar jaata hai.

hi: ज़्यादा पीस चेक नहीं हो रहे
hg: zyada pieces check nahi ho rahe
available to check error

a.en: You cannot check more than was received in Job Work minus what was already checked, and alteration plus rejected cannot be more than checked. Lower the numbers to what the message says.
a.hi: Job Work में जितने आए उनमें से पहले चेक हुए घटाकर जो बचे, उससे ज़्यादा चेक नहीं हो सकते, और alteration + rejected, checked से ज़्यादा नहीं हो सकते। गिनती मैसेज के हिसाब से कम करें।
a.hg: Job Work mein jitne aaye unmein se pehle check hue ghata kar jo bache, usse zyada check nahi ho sakte, aur alteration + rejected, checked se zyada nahi ho sakte. Ginti message ke hisab se kam kijiye.

hi: ऑल्टरेशन के लिए पीस कैसे दें
hg: alteration ke liye pieces kaise de
kharab pieces tailor ko kaise de

a.en: Choose Issued for alteration, press + Issue for alteration, pick the SKU in — Select a flagged article —, the Employment type… and Employee, type Pieces and press Issue.
a.hi: Issued for alteration चुनें, + Issue for alteration दबाएँ, — Select a flagged article — में SKU, Employment type… और Employee चुनें, Pieces लिखें और Issue दबाएँ।
a.hg: Issued for alteration chuniye, + Issue for alteration dabaiye, — Select a flagged article — mein SKU, Employment type… aur Employee chuniye, Pieces likhiye aur Issue da…

a.hi: Received back from alteration चुनें, + Receive from alteration दबाएँ, — What is coming back — और — Received by — चुनें, Received लिखें, उसे Mended और Still wrong में बा…
a.hg: Received back from alteration chuniye, + Receive from alteration dabaiye, — What is coming back — aur — Received by — chuniye, Received likhiye, use Mended aur Still wrong…

hi: QC चेक कैसे बदलें
hg: qc check kaise edit kare
qc entry delete kaise kare

a.en: Press Edit on a row in Checks or Issued for alteration and change the numbers, person or remarks. Only an admin sees the date and Delete. Entries from Spotting & touching cannot be edit…
a.hi: Checks या Issued for alteration की लाइन पर Edit दबाकर गिनती, व्यक्ति या remarks बदलें। तारीख और Delete सिर्फ़ admin को दिखते हैं। Spotting & touching वाली एंट्री यहाँ edit नहीं होती।
a.hg: Checks ya Issued for alteration ki line par Edit dabakar ginti, vyakti ya remarks badaliye. Date aur Delete sirf admin ko dikhte hain. Spotting & touching wali entry yahan edit nahi hoti.

en: this account has no quality control access
hi: QC की अनुमति नहीं
hg: qc ki permission nahi hai
qc screen khali hai

a.en: Your account has not been given any Quality Control view. Ask an admin to give you the QC job you do (checks, alteration or receiving back).
a.hi: आपके अकाउंट को Quality Control का कोई व्यू नहीं मिला है। आप जो QC काम करते हैं (checks, alteration या वापस लेना) उसकी अनुमति admin से माँगें।
a.hg: Aapke account ko Quality Control ka koi view nahi mila hai. Aap jo QC kaam karte hain (checks, alteration ya wapas lena) uski anumati admin se maangiye.

en: where do pieces go after qc pass

hg: qc pass ke baad maal kahan jata hai
qc ke baad kya hota hai

a.hi: Shopify या online ऑर्डर के पास हुए पीस Order Console पर shipping टीम के पास जाते हैं। बाकी ऑर्डर के पास हुए पीस Finished Goods → From QC — to accept में रुकते हैं, जहाँ स्टोर टीम Accept दबाकर उन्हें Indi…
a.hg: Shopify ya online order ke pass hue pieces Order Console par shipping team ke paas jaate hain. Baaki orders ke pass hue pieces Finished Goods → From QC — to accept mein rukte hain, jahan store team Accept…

hi: QC क्या है
hg: qc kya hai
qc ka matlab

a.en: QC (Quality Control) is checking the stitched pieces. On Quality Control you record how many were Checked, sent For alteration and Rejected; OK is worked out for you.
a.hi: QC (Quality Control) सिले पीसों की जाँच है। Quality Control पर लिखें कितने Checked हुए, कितने For alteration गए और कितने Rejected; OK अपने आप निकलता है।
a.hg: QC (Quality Control) sile piece ki jaanch hai. Quality Control par likhiye kitne Checked hue, kitne For alteration gaye aur kitne Rejected; OK apne aap nikalta hai.

hi: ऑल्टरेशन क्या है
hg: alteration kya hai
alteration ka matlab

a.en: Alteration means a faulty piece that can still be mended. QC marks it For alteration, issues it to a tailor in Issued for alteration, and when it comes back splits it into Mended and Sti…
a.hi: Alteration का मतलब ऐसा खराब पीस जो अभी ठीक हो सकता है। QC उसे For alteration लिखता है, Issued for alteration में दर्ज़ी को देता है, और लौटने पर Mended और Still wrong में बाँटता है।
a.hg: Alteration ka matlab aisa kharab piece jo abhi theek ho sakta hai. QC use For alteration likhta hai, Issued for alteration mein darzi ko deta hai, aur lautne par Mended aur Still wrong…

a.hg: Har Job Work entry ke liye: waiting = 5 October 2026 se receive hue pieces (har receipt apni date par, line me likhe receive se zyada nahi; legacy LEG- order ki har receipt gini jaati hai, 5 October se pehle wali bhi)…

en: what happens when i press qc pass
qc pass effect on order console
hi: QC pass दबाने से क्या होता है
hg: qc pass dabane se kya hota hai
qc pass ka order console par asar

a.en: QC pass saves a check on that Job Work entry (checked = passed = the pieces you typed), so the order counts them as made at once; the weekly production figures count QC passes on the day passed, under the karigar they…
a.hi: QC pass उस जॉब वर्क एंट्री पर एक चेक सेव करता है (चेक = पास = टाइप किए पीस), इसलिए ऑर्डर उन्हें तुरंत बना हुआ गिनता है; वीकली प्रोडक्शन नंबर QC पास को पास वाले दिन, उस कारीगर के नाम गिनते हैं जिससे पीस आए।
a.hg: QC pass us Job Work entry par ek check save karta hai (checked = passed = type kiye pieces), isliye order unhe turant bana hua ginta hai; weekly production numbers QC pass ko pass wale din, us karigar ke naam ginte ha…

en: how spotting touching still there worked out
sent to spotting counted as passed?
hi: Spotting & touching में Still there कैसे निकलता है
hg: spotting touching me still there kaise nikalta hai
spotting me bheje piece pass gine jaate hai kya

a.en: Pieces sent to spotting or touching are taken out of Waiting for QC but not passed. Still there = sent − (back passed + rejected). Back — QC pass is a QC pass for that order; Reject counts them rejected.
a.hi: स्पॉटिंग या टचिंग में भेजे पीस Waiting for QC से निकल जाते हैं पर पास नहीं गिने जाते। Still there = भेजे − (वापस पास + रिजेक्ट)। Back — QC pass उस ऑर्डर का QC पास है; Reject उन्हें रिजेक्ट गिनता है।
a.hg: Spotting ya touching me bheje pieces Waiting for QC se nikal jaate hai par pass nahi gine jaate. Still there = bheje − (wapas pass + reject). Back — QC pass us order ka QC pass hai; Reject unhe reject gi…

en: back from karigars in qc ledger from where
hi: QC ledger के कॉलम का मतलब
hg: qc ledger ke column ka matlab
back from karigars kahan se aata hai

a.hi: हर दिन एक लाइन: Back from karigars उस दिन की जॉब वर्क रिसीट हैं; QC pass, To spotting, To touching, हर एक से वापस पास, Rejected after spotting / touching, All passed, For alteration और Rejected at QC (Checks फ़ॉर्म)।
a.hg: Har din ek line: Back from karigars us din ki Job Work receipts hai; QC pass, To spotting, To touching, har ek se wapas pass, Rejected after spotting / touching, All passed, For alteration aur Rejected at QC (Checks f…

en: checks form available to check formula
ok pieces how calculated in check
hi: Checks फ़ॉर्म में available कैसे निकलता है
hg: checks form me available kaise nikalta hai
ok piece kaise bante hai

a.en: Available to check = all pieces of that SKU received in the Job Work Register − all pieces of it already checked. OK fills itself: checked − for alteration − rejected.
a.hi: Available to check = उस SKU के जॉब वर्क रजिस्टर में रिसीव हुए सारे पीस − उसके पहले से चेक हुए सारे पीस। OK खुद भरता है: चेक − अल्टरेशन − रिजेक्ट।
a.hg: Available to check = us SKU ke Job Work Register me receive hue saare pieces − uske pehle se check hue saare pieces. OK khud bharta hai: checked − for alteration − rejected.

en: why checks available differs from waiting for qc
hi: Checks का available और Waiting for QC अलग क्यों
hg: checks ka available aur waiting for qc alag kyu
qc ke do alag pending number

a.hi: दोनों अलग चीज़ नापते हैं: Waiting for QC हर जॉब वर्क एंट्री का और सिर्फ़ 5 अक्टूबर 2026 से रिसीव पीस (legacy LEG- ऑर्डर के किसी भी तारीख के); Checks फ़ॉर्म का left to check पूरे SKU का, हर समय, सारे ऑर्डर मिलाकर। रोज़…
a.hg: Dono alag cheez naapte hai: Waiting for QC har Job Work entry ka aur sirf 5 October 2026 se receive pieces (legacy LEG- order ke kisi bhi date ke); Checks form ka left to check poore SKU ka, har time, saare orders mil…

hi: अल्टरेशन इश्यू की लिमिट कैसे बनती है
hg: alteration issue ki limit kaise banti hai
available to issue ka matlab

a.en: Available to issue = pieces QC flagged for alteration on that SKU − pieces already issued for alteration. A return is booked against one issuance, never more than is still out on it, and mended + still wrong must equa…
a.hi: Available to issue = उस SKU पर QC ने अल्टरेशन के लिए जो पीस निकाले − पहले से अल्टरेशन को इश्यू पीस। वापसी एक इश्यू पर दर्ज होती है, उस पर बाहर बचे से ज़्यादा नहीं, और mended + still wrong = जितने वापस आए।
a.hg: Available to issue = us SKU par QC ne alteration ke liye jo pieces nikale − pehle se alteration ko issue pieces. Wapsi ek issue par darj hoti hai, us par bahar bache se zyada nahi, aur mended + still wrong = jitne wap…

en: cannot edit qc check belongs to spotting
hi: QC चेक एडिट क्यों नहीं हो रहा
hg: qc check edit kyu nahi ho rha
belongs to spotting & touching ka matlab

a.en: Editing a QC check or alteration issue needs Can edit production entries; the check date is an admin's, and deleting is an admin's. A send to spotting or touching, or a lot back from there, cannot be edited at …
a.hi: QC चेक या अल्टरेशन इश्यू एडिट करने के लिए Can edit production entries चाहिए; चेक की तारीख और डिलीट एडमिन का काम है। स्पॉटिंग या टचिंग में भेजा या वहाँ से वापस आया लॉट बिल्कुल एडिट नहीं होता।
a.hg: QC check ya alteration issue edit karne ke liye Can edit production entries chahiye; check ki date aur delete admin ka kaam hai. Spotting ya touching me bheja ya wahan se wapas aaya lot bilkul edit nahi hota.

en: how many pieces can qc check
qc check blocked more than received
hi: QC कितने पीस चेक कर सकता है
hg: qc kitne piece check kar sakta h
receive se zyada qc check ruk gaya

a.en: QC can check at most what was received in the Job Work Register for that SKU and order minus what is already checked, and For alteration + Rejected cannot be more than Checked.
a.hi: QC ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा उतना चेक कर सकता है जितना उस SKU और ऑर्डर का Job Work Register में receive हुआ, उसमें से पहले चेक हुआ घटाकर, और For alteration + Rejected, Checked से ज़्यादा नहीं हो सकता।
a.hg: QC zyada se zyada utna check kar sakta hai jitna us SKU aur order ka Job Work Register me receive hua, usme se pehle check hua ghata kar, aur For alteration + Rejected, Checked se zyada nahi ho sakta.

title.hi: Waiting for QC के पीस पास करना
title.hg: Waiting for QC ke piece pass karna

steps.en: Choose Waiting for QC in the first box. Each line is a karigar's receipt, oldest first.
steps.hi: पहले बॉक्स में Waiting for QC चुनें। हर लाइन एक कारीगर की रसीद है, सबसे पुरानी पहले।
steps.hg: Pehle box me Waiting for QC chuniye. Har line ek karigar ki receipt hai, sabse purani pehle.

steps.en: Looking for one? Type the SKU, article or karigar here.
steps.hi: कोई खास ढूँढ रहे हैं? यहाँ SKU, आर्टिकल या कारीगर लिखें।
steps.hg: Koi khaas dhoondh rahe hain? Yahan SKU, article ya karigar likhiye.

steps.en: In Pieces on the line, type how many you checked — it starts at all that are waiting. Fewer leaves the rest waiting.
steps.hi: लाइन के Pieces में लिखें कितने चेक किए — शुरू में सारे बाकी भरे होते हैं। कम लिखेंगे तो बाकी रुके रहेंगे।
steps.hg: Line ke Pieces me likhiye kitne check kiye — shuru me saare baaki bhare hote hain. Kam likhenge to baaki ruke rahenge.

steps.en: A stain? Press Spotting. A missed print? Touching. They come back from the Spotting & touching view.
steps.hi: दाग है? Spotting दबाएँ। प्रिंट छूटा है? Touching। ये Spotting & touching व्यू से वापस आते हैं।
steps.hg: Daag hai? Spotting dabaiye. Print chhoota hai? Touching. Ye Spotting & touching view se wapas aate hain.

steps.en: Press QC pass on the line. This saves for real — the pieces count as made on the Order Console.
steps.hi: लाइन पर QC pass दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है — पीस Order Console पर बने हुए गिने जाते हैं।
steps.hg: Line par QC pass dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai — piece Order Console par bane hue gine jaate hain.

steps.en: Done — this line says it was accepted. A red line says what to fix, like more pieces than are waiting.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है कि accept हुआ। लाल लाइन बताएगी क्या ठीक करना है, जैसे बाकी से ज़्यादा पीस।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai ki accept hua. Laal line batayegi kya theek karna hai, jaise baaki se zyada piece.

title.en: Take pieces back from spotting or touching
title.hi: Spotting या touching से पीस वापस लेना
title.hg: Spotting ya touching se piece wapas lena

steps.en: Choose Spotting & touching in the first box.
steps.hi: पहले बॉक्स में Spotting & touching चुनें।
steps.hg: Pehle box me Spotting & touching chuniye.

steps.en: Type the SKU or karigar to find the lot.
steps.hi: लॉट ढूँढने के लिए SKU या कारीगर लिखें।
steps.hg: Lot dhoondhne ke liye SKU ya karigar likhiye.

steps.en: In Pieces, type how many came back. Fewer leaves the rest there.
steps.hi: Pieces में लिखें कितने वापस आए। कम लिखेंगे तो बाकी वहीं रहेंगे।
steps.hg: Pieces me likhiye kitne wapas aaye. Kam likhenge to baaki wahin rahenge.

steps.en: Still not good? Press Reject instead.
steps.hi: अब भी ठीक नहीं? उसकी जगह Reject दबाएँ।
steps.hg: Ab bhi theek nahi? Uski jagah Reject dabaiye.

steps.en: Press Back — QC pass. This saves the pass for real.
steps.hi: Back — QC pass दबाएँ। यह पास असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Back — QC pass dabaiye. Ye pass asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — this line says it is back and passed.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है कि वापस आया और पास हुआ।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai ki wapas aaya aur pass hua.

steps.en: Let's record a quality check. I'll light up each box in turn.
steps.hi: चलिए क्वालिटी चेक दर्ज करते हैं। मैं एक-एक बॉक्स दिखाऊँगी।
steps.hg: Chaliye quality check record karte hain. Main ek-ek box dikhaungi.

steps.en: Choose Checks in the first box — the check form is there.
steps.hi: पहले बॉक्स में Checks चुनें — चेक का फ़ॉर्म वहीं है।
steps.hg: Pehle box me Checks chuniye — check ka form wahin hai.

steps.en: Press + Record a check.
steps.hi: + Record a check दबाएँ।
steps.hg: + Record a check dabaiye.

steps.en: Normally Received in Job Work. Choose Any SKU (free inspection) only for pieces that never went out on an issue.
steps.hi: आमतौर पर Received in Job Work। Any SKU (free inspection) तभी जब पीस कभी issue पर नहीं गए।
steps.hg: Aam taur par Received in Job Work. Any SKU (free inspection) tabhi jab piece kabhi issue par nahi gaye.

steps.en: Choose the Article type — or type the SKU in the SKU box and the item fills itself.
steps.hi: Article type चुनें — या SKU बॉक्स में SKU लिखें, आइटम अपने आप भर जाएगा।
steps.hg: Article type chuniye — ya SKU box me SKU likhiye, item apne aap bhar jayega.

steps.en: Choose the Subtype.
steps.hi: Subtype चुनें।
steps.hg: Subtype chuniye.

steps.en: Choose the Colour.
steps.hi: Colour चुनें।
steps.hg: Colour chuniye.

steps.en: Choose the Size. The SKU box then fills itself.
steps.hi: Size चुनें। फिर SKU बॉक्स अपने आप भर जाता है।
steps.hg: Size chuniye. Phir SKU box apne aap bhar jaata hai.

steps.en: Who checked the pieces? (The type box beside it narrows the list.)
steps.hi: पीस किसने चेक किए? (बगल का type बॉक्स लिस्ट छोटी करता है।)
steps.hg: Piece kisne check kiye? (Bagal ka type box list chhoti karta hai.)

steps.en: Pick the Order No these pieces belong to — needed whenever the SKU is on an order.
steps.hi: ये पीस जिस ऑर्डर के हैं वह Order No चुनें — SKU किसी ऑर्डर पर हो तो ज़रूरी है।
steps.hg: Ye piece jis order ke hain wo Order No chuniye — SKU kisi order par ho to zaroori hai.

steps.en: How many pieces were Checked? The line below shows how many may still be checked.
steps.hi: कितने पीस Checked हुए? नीचे की लाइन बताती है और कितने चेक हो सकते हैं।
steps.hg: Kitne piece Checked hue? Neeche ki line batati hai aur kitne check ho sakte hain.

steps.en: How many need For alteration? Leave empty if none.
steps.hi: कितने For alteration जाएँगे? कोई नहीं तो खाली छोड़ें।
steps.hg: Kitne For alteration jayenge? Koi nahi to khaali chhodiye.

steps.en: How many are Rejected? Leave empty if none. OK fills itself.
steps.hi: कितने Rejected हुए? कोई नहीं तो खाली छोड़ें। OK अपने आप भरता है।
steps.hg: Kitne Rejected hue? Koi nahi to khaali chhodiye. OK apne aap bharta hai.

steps.en: Press Save check. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: Save check दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Save check dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — this line says how many passed. A red line says what to fix.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है कितने पास हुए। लाल लाइन बताएगी क्या ठीक करना है।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai kitne pass hue. Laal line batayegi kya theek karna hai.

steps.en: Choose Issued for alteration in the first box.
steps.hi: पहले बॉक्स में Issued for alteration चुनें।
steps.hg: Pehle box me Issued for alteration chuniye.

steps.en: Press + Issue for alteration.
steps.hi: + Issue for alteration दबाएँ।
steps.hg: + Issue for alteration dabaiye.

steps.en: Pick the SKU in — Select a flagged article —. Only SKUs QC sent for alteration are listed.
steps.hi: — Select a flagged article — में SKU चुनें। सिर्फ़ वही SKU हैं जिन्हें QC ने alteration में भेजा।
steps.hg: — Select a flagged article — me SKU chuniye. Sirf wahi SKU hain jinhe QC ne alteration me bheja.

steps.en: Choose the Employment type….
steps.hi: Employment type… चुनें।
steps.hg: Employment type… chuniye.

steps.en: Pick the Employee who will mend them.
steps.hi: जो ठीक करेगा वह Employee चुनें।
steps.hg: Jo theek karega wo Employee chuniye.

steps.en: How many Pieces? The line below shows how many may go.
steps.hi: कितने Pieces? नीचे की लाइन बताती है कितने जा सकते हैं।
steps.hg: Kitne Pieces? Neeche ki line batati hai kitne ja sakte hain.

steps.en: Remarks (optional) — what needs mending.
steps.hi: Remarks (optional) — क्या ठीक करना है।
steps.hg: Remarks (optional) — kya theek karna hai.

steps.en: Press Issue. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: Issue दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Issue dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — the issue is in the list below. A red line says what to fix.
steps.hi: हो गया — issue नीचे लिस्ट में है। लाल लाइन बताएगी क्या ठीक करना है।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — issue neeche list me hai. Laal line batayegi kya theek karna hai.

steps.en: Choose Received back from alteration in the first box.
steps.hi: पहले बॉक्स में Received back from alteration चुनें।
steps.hg: Pehle box me Received back from alteration chuniye.

steps.en: Press + Receive from alteration.
steps.hi: + Receive from alteration दबाएँ।
steps.hg: + Receive from alteration dabaiye.

steps.en: Pick the issue in — What is coming back —.
steps.hi: — What is coming back — में वह issue चुनें।
steps.hg: — What is coming back — me wo issue chuniye.

steps.en: Who took them in? Pick — Received by —.
steps.hi: किसने लिए? — Received by — चुनें।
steps.hg: Kisne liye? — Received by — chuniye.

steps.en: How many pieces came back? Type Received.
steps.hi: कितने पीस वापस आए? Received लिखें।
steps.hg: Kitne piece wapas aaye? Received likhiye.

steps.en: Split them: Mended (pass now)…
steps.hi: बाँटें: Mended (अब पास)…
steps.hg: Baantiye: Mended (ab pass)…

steps.en: …and Still wrong. The two must add up to Received.
steps.hi: …और Still wrong। दोनों मिलकर Received के बराबर हों।
steps.hg: …aur Still wrong. Dono milkar Received ke barabar hon.

steps.en: Press Receive. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: Receive दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Receive dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — this line says how many are still with them.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है कितने अभी भी उनके पास हैं।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai kitne abhi bhi unke paas hain.

title.en: Edit a QC check or alteration issue
title.hi: QC चेक या alteration issue बदलना
title.hg: QC check ya alteration issue edit karna

steps.en: Choose Checks or Issued for alteration in the first box.
steps.hi: पहले बॉक्स में Checks या Issued for alteration चुनें।
steps.hg: Pehle box me Checks ya Issued for alteration chuniye.

steps.en: Type the SKU or person to find the row.
steps.hi: लाइन ढूँढने के लिए SKU या व्यक्ति लिखें।
steps.hg: Line dhoondhne ke liye SKU ya vyakti likhiye.

steps.en: Press Edit on the row you want.
steps.hi: जिस लाइन को बदलना है उस पर Edit दबाएँ।
steps.hg: Jis line ko badalna hai us par Edit dabaiye.

steps.en: Change the numbers, the person or the remarks. Only an admin sees the date and Delete.
steps.hi: संख्या, व्यक्ति या remarks बदलें। तारीख और Delete सिर्फ़ एडमिन को दिखते हैं।
steps.hg: Number, vyakti ya remarks badliye. Date aur Delete sirf admin ko dikhte hain.

steps.en: Press Save. This saves the change for real.
steps.hi: Save दबाएँ। यह बदलाव असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Save dabaiye. Ye badlav asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — the row shows the new figures.
steps.hi: हो गया — लाइन पर नए आँकड़े दिख रहे हैं।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — line par naye aankde dikh rahe hain.
